New York, watch Delhi. India's home minister Amit Shah told GJEPC's 52nd Awards in Mumbai that India must own the entire lab-grown diamond chain — machines to global retail.

That reaches into 47th Street's own ground: America is the world's largest diamond market. Shah's own estimate, via Rapaport: lab-grown will grow to nearly 50 times today's whole diamond market.
